name: FreeMealRate
definition: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free/reduced meals Formula: FreeMealEligibleCount / EnrollmentK12. Inputs: FreeMealEligibleCount = tb001.cl0022; EnrollmentK12 = tb001.cl0019
aliases: eligible free or reduced price meal rate

name: EnrollmentGap
definition: Difference between K-12 and ages 5-17 enrollment Formula: EnrollmentK12 - EnrollmentAge5to17. Inputs: EnrollmentK12 = tb001.cl0019; EnrollmentAge5to17 = tb001.cl0024

name: AvgMathScore
definition: Mean of school average math scores Formula: AVG(MathAvgScore). Inputs: MathAvgScore = tb003.cl0041

name: BorderlessCardPct
definition: Share of cards that are borderless Formula: COUNT(BorderColor) / COUNT(Card). Inputs: BorderColor = tb004.cl0093 WHERE cl0093 = 'borderless'; Card = tb004.cl0089

name: ChineseSimplifiedPct
definition: Share of cards available in Simplified Chinese Formula: COUNT(Language where Chinese Simplified) / COUNT(Card). Inputs: Language = tb005.cl0163; Card = tb004.cl0089
aliases: percentage of cards in Chinese Simplified

name: StorySpotlightNoTextPct
definition: Share of Story Spotlight cards lacking a text box Formula: COUNT(StorySpotlightFlag AND TextlessFlag) / COUNT(Card). Inputs: StorySpotlightFlag = tb004.cl0122; TextlessFlag = tb004.cl0122 WHERE cl0122 = 0; Card = tb004.cl0089
aliases: percentage of Story Spotlight cards without text box

name: PowerfulFoilPct
definition: Share of cards with powerful foil versions Formula: COUNT(FoilFlag) / COUNT(Card). Inputs: FoilFlag = tb004.cl0094 WHERE cl0094 IS NOT NULL AND cl0095 IS NOT NULL; Card = tb004.cl0089

name: PremiumSegmentPct
definition: Share of premium-segment gas stations Formula: COUNT(Segment='premium') / COUNT(GasStation). Inputs: Segment = tb011.cl0188; GasStation = tb010.cl0184
aliases: percentage of premium against overall segment

name: AvgPricePerItem
definition: Average price paid per item purchased Formula: SUM(PricePerItem) / SUM(ItemCount). Inputs: PricePerItem = tb013.cl0197; ItemCount = tb013.cl0196

name: HighConsumptionPct
definition: Share of transactions consuming more than 528.3 Formula: COUNT(GasConsumption > 528.3) / COUNT(Transaction). Inputs: GasConsumption = tb014.cl0198; Transaction = tb013.cl0190
aliases: percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3

name: UnemploymentIncrementRate
definition: Percentage change in unemployment rate from 1995 to 1996 Formula: (UnemploymentRate1996 - UnemploymentRate1995) / UnemploymentRate1995 * 100. Inputs: UnemploymentRate1995 = tb019.cl0213; UnemploymentRate1996 = tb019.cl0214

name: SalaryGap
definition: Difference between highest and lowest average salary Formula: MAX(AverageSalary) - MIN(AverageSalary). Inputs: AverageSalary = tb019.cl0219
aliases: gap between lowest and highest average salary

name: HamiltonNonFirstTrackRate
definition: Share of Hamilton races where he was not in 1st position Formula: COUNT(DriverRacePosition > 1) / COUNT(RaceNumber) * 100. Inputs: DriverRacePosition = tb029.cl0267; RaceNumber = tb027.cl0259

name: BudgetRatio
definition: Ratio of budget between two events in a category Formula: SUM(BudgetAmount for EventName='Yearly Kickoff') / SUM(BudgetAmount for EventName='October Meeting'). Inputs: BudgetAmount = tb040.cl0310; EventName = tb036.cl0289

name: ClientAge
definition: Age computed from birth date Formula: YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - YEAR(ClientBirthDate). Inputs: ClientBirthDate = tb017.cl0207

name: DriverAge
definition: Age computed from driver birth date Formula: YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - YEAR(DriverBirthDate). Inputs: DriverBirthDate = tb025.cl0257

name: AtomCountPerMolecule
definition: Count of atoms in a molecule Formula: COUNT(Atom). Inputs: Atom = tb038.cl0299; Molecule = tb037.cl0295

name: CardType
definition: Credit card types/levels held by clients

name: TransactionType
definition: Types of bank transactions

name: CircuitCountry
definition: Countries hosting F1 circuits

name: BudgetCategory
definition: Categories of student club budgets

name: EventStatus
definition: Status values of student club events

name: TShirtSize
